title: Blink with a given rhythm
task: Make GP25 (the LED) an output and change it 8 times, 250 ms apart: on, off, on, off, … (it ends off), then return 0. The tests measure the changes on the pin: 8 of them, a period of 500 ms and 250 ms high, within 1 %.
